## Steps and checks

- Open a fresh browser as Daniel (`daniel`).
- Go to `/check-in/ns-ci?sources=behind` in the demo.
- **Check:** “What’s the number this week?” is shown (else: the check-in’s number step did not open).
- **Check:** “That is too old to fill in.” is shown in the reading of the number in the check-in (else: a reading more than 7 days old is not said to be too old).
- **Check:** (`entry`) met when `(await field.inputValue()) === ''`, where `const field = p.getByLabel('This week’s value')`. Else it says: the field opened with “{field.inputValue()}”.
- **Check:** (`attention`) met when `/CI analytics last read this on \w{3} \d{1,2} \w{3}, \d+ days ago\./.test(said) && (await block.locator('svg').count()) > 0`, where `const block = p.locator('.ci-reading-block')`; `const said = (await block.innerText()).replace(/\s+/g, ' ')`. Else it says: the block says “{said}”, or has no warning mark.
- _Note:_ The old value is never offered: nothing says what the source read, and nothing confirms it.
- **Check:** (`finish`) met when `!/From CI analytics|said \d|Confirm/.test(said) && (await p.getByRole('button', { name: /^Confirm/ }).count()) === 0`, where `const block = p.locator('.ci-reading-block')`; `const said = (await block.innerText()).replace(/\s+/g, ' ')`. Else it says: the old reading is on the page: “{said}”.
- **Check:** (`progress`) the “No new number this week” button in the reading of the number in the check-in is visible (else: No new number this week is not offered).
- **Check:** Checkpoint “too old”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- **Step.** Press the “Next(: / $)” button.
- **Check:** “Type this week’s number.” is shown (else: Continue with an empty field does not ask for the number).
- **Check:** (`errors`) scored as met here.
- **Check:** (`logged`) scored as met here.
- Close this browser.
